MASTER SERVICES AGREEMENT

This Agreement is made on April 1, 2024 between Alpha Inc. (the "Customer") and Beta LLC (the "Provider").

ARTICLE I. DEFINITIONS
Section 1.1 Definitions
"Services" means the services described in Schedule A.
"Deliverables" means the work product delivered under Section 3.2.

ARTICLE II. SERVICES
Section 2.1 Performance
(a) The Provider shall perform the Services with reasonable care.
(b) The Provider may use subcontractors only with the Customer's consent.
Section 2.2 Term
This Agreement ends on March 31, 2025 unless renewed under Section 5.1.

ARTICLE III. FEES
Section 3.1 Fees
The Customer shall pay $5,000 per month.
Section 3.2 Payment
(a) Invoices are due within 30 days of receipt.
(i) Late amounts bear interest at 1.5 percent per month.
(ii) The Customer shall not withhold payment of undisputed amounts.
(b) The Provider must deliver the Deliverables before payment is due.

ARTICLE IV. TERMINATION
Section 4.1 Termination for Cause
Either party may terminate this Agreement if the other breaches Section 3.2(a)(ii) and fails to cure within 15 business days.
